sermons.title: Who Were the Sons of God?
sermons.speaker: Trent Cornwell
sermons.notesHtml: BIG IDEA: Regardless of how we interpret the details of Genesis 6, one truth is unavoidable — the secret mysteries of fallen angels are not the reason for our fall. We must take responsibility for our own rebellion. Jesus is the only answer.
